title: Add 3 more gated teaching datasets to datasets.yml
context: This backlog task expands datasets.yml with three more teaching datasets, each run through the gate-001 gate with full license snapshot and provenance, broadening the data available to later modules.
objective: Add at least 3 more teaching datasets to datasets.yml, each fully recorded and PASSING the gate (or excluded with reason), reviewed by License+Data-Ethics.
acceptanceCriteria: At least 3 additional sources fully recorded against the gate-001 schema; each PASSING the gate or excluded with reason.
Each record has a license snapshot (committed text + SHA-256 + archival URL) and a vendor-vs-fetch decision.
No record has accessTier outside the permitted enum; no individual-level record without deIdentified=true + basis.
Reviewed and signed off by License+Data-Ethics; output licensed CC-BY-4.0.
